title: fun relaxing incremental game about restoring the dead land. 5 worlds . spent a few days on this and had a ton of fun.
author: barret232hxc
selftext:
You can play it for free in your browser or on your phone here  >>> [https://w.run/barret/make-it-rain-on-them-grows](https://w.run/barret/make-it-rain-on-them-grows)

  
hope you enjoy. It's super relaxing and chill

comments.author: CashFirm573
comments.body: So you copied this game, recently someone posted full 3d version of this same concept same crap that's on steam, you seen it put it into Claude asked it create you crappy version.

replies.author: barret232hxc
replies.body:
no I was making a weekly gamejam theme game and making something I wanted to play I don't have claude. I use opencode free models just for fun. I'm not trying to sell anything just making a game I personally enjoy. I like pixel art and always have and always will so it's what I gravitate towards. 

I just like to make simple games that I find enjoyable and share them with others. This doesn't make any money it's just something I made in a few days b/c I like to play cozy relaxing games

comments.author: WarmestMachine99
comments.body: At least credit the original developer whose idea you stole from Reddit and ran through Claude to make it worse.

replies.author: barret232hxc
replies.body:
i don't use claude for this, i use opencode free models and I didn't steal anything?

I just join in the discord for where the game was hosted they do weekly themes and it was weather so I wanted to make a cozy incremental game b/c I like cozy games and incremental games and I like pixel art.

comments.author: forever_second
comments.body: is this what gaming is now, just stealing other people's ideas and making much worse ai versions? how depressing.

replies.author: barret232hxc
replies.body: i dunno what you're talking about ? this was for a weekly game jam theme of weather in the platform it's hosted on. I like pixel art so that's what i gravitate towards. it's just for fun and a game I actually enjoy and like to play and want to share with anyone else who is interested. it makes zero money. and i dunno what you mean much worse version. I have never played an incremental game about a cloud raining on destroyed lands. My thought was like katamari damacy you get bigger and can restore more land. I use opencode free models for this to enter in the weekly theme

comments.author: Ok-Pirate5732
comments.body: Yeah bro we all saw it on Reddit just like you

replies.author: barret232hxc
replies.body: i am in a discoard that does weekly game jam themes on their ai platform and the theme was weather. I just like making simple cozy games I enjoy? i'm not sure what the problem is to share that with people

comments.author: Disastrous-Gain5870
comments.body:
Stolen. People like you give devs who use AI a bad name, and we should straight up ban these people from the sub.

You really couldn’t just come up with your own idea? Creatively bankrupt, the lot of you.

replies.author: barret232hxc
replies.body:
what is stolen? please show me an incremental game about a cloud raining to make growth come back that is done in 2..5 D pixel art and that is completely free to play for anyone. with an incremental upgrade tree that you can just chill and relax to? it was for a weekly theme on the platform it's hosted the theme was weather and i used opencode free models to make the game . I like to make simple cozy games with pixel art b/c that's what I like so I was just sharing with other people. I have never played any game like this before? so I'm not sure why you are accusing me of. I would love to play the game you are accusing me of stealing side by side and see how it's stealing a game. The concept was mostly from katamari damacy, you get to be a bigger cloud through incremental upgrade tree and the last level you are on the globe restoring the globe? I feel like you all are making assumptions and didn't even play the game. it's like you have so much hate in your hearts. 

I am just making games for fun. I use the free models b/c I don't have a lot of money to spend, my daughter likes the game and thinks it's cute I figured i'd share b/c it's relaxing to me personally.

comments.author: avodhel
comments.body: At least change the idea and destroy the lands with a  electrically charged cloud or someting. It would be still not original but different idea.
